notes.title: Lion Quest Infinity 1.2.2
notes.content:
Here comes Lion Quest Infinity version 1.2.2. This update adds and changes the following:

[list]
[*]Small dialogue adjustments and numerous spelling/ grammar corrections
[*]Corrected a couple of situations where the label for the speaking character was wrong
[*]Fixed some issues with the player's jump not curbing correctly
[*]E key can now also be used for interactions
[*]Fix for lamp triggers not working properly in the player's house
[*]Engine upgrade
[*]Splash screen has been removed
[*]Miscellaneous shader upgrades
[*]Minor geometry fixes
[*]Minor physics revisions
[*]Fixed an issue where clear blue trail objects would revert to their original colour if they made contact with the game camera
[/list]

notes.title: New year, new patch
notes.content:
Lion Quest Infinity version 1.2.1 is here. This is just a small patch with the following changes:

[list]
[*]Revisions to Missile Kid collisions
[*]Minor collider adjustments to the Rooftop Pool map
[*]Fixed some issues where the input maps would not load correctly
[*]Engine upgrade
[*]Spelling and grammar
[*]Pause menu text adjustment for LQVi
[*]Minor icon fix in LQVi
[*]Fix for issues swapping resolution
[/list]

notes.title: Lion Quest Infinity Launches on Steam
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39023933/8e07d243bfe2b19887cc7316be4d005d0eb3e374.jpg[/img]

Hello. Happy launch day! Lion Quest Infinity has been in development for five years now so I'm very excited indeed to now be able to say that the game is out and ready for you to play.

Lion Quest Infinity started out as a sequel to the original Lion Quest game I released back in 2016, but as a ground-up reinvention of the series in 3D it quickly moved beyond this. There are certainly throwbacks and Easter eggs to be discovered for players of the original, but the focus is on a brand-new story with no previous knowledge required.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39023933/07973b0998f19645182630c1a56d64b3f0c40500.gif[/img]

Jethro the Lion steals a magic grandfather clock, setting in motion an epic adventure that takes him and friends across the universe and through time and space.

But that's not all. Lion Quest is a fantasy adventure by night but your days are spent in the real world, working an office job. This new element gives an unexpected twist to the genre, with plenty of surprises in store for players.

[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39023933/774e89d866b30b78ab63e953c2b9b12f1c823df4.gif][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39023933/774e89d866b30b78ab63e953c2b9b12f1c823df4.gif[/img][/url]

Thanks for checking it out and I hope you enjoy your trip to the Lion Quest Universe!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39023933/588ea18de3af1b9644d128cc42087ab87d6a2e1b.png[/img]

notes.title: The Lion Quest Infinity Special Demo
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39023933/a3cdff792b0238ec5ebdb861b8f4da980bf6365f.jpg[/img]

Hello! Today I'm pleased to announce that a demo version of Lion Quest Infinity will be available to play ahead of the its launch on March 5th as part of the Steam Games Festival.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39023933/78e37b516fa9aa16effc79c38af509760b22682c.jpg[/img]

This is a limited time event! The Steam Games Festival runs from today (February 3 2021) until February 9 2021. During this time you will be able to download the SPECIAL DEMO VERSION of Lion Quest Infinity, which include both the first day and night levels from the game.

Please note that demo will not be available for download once the festival has concluded. If you would like to check out Lion Quest Infinity before the game's launch, this is your chance!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39023933/adb76098b6fdedb22610bc09736226f181090a90.jpg[/img]

notes.title: Lion Quest Infinity – Launching March 5th 2021
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39023933/aedb188ec6ac3731160e28ed1bab84fb286ced9e.jpg[/img]

Hello again and happy new year. To celebrate, I bring news regarding the upcoming return of Jethro the Lion and Jefferson the Fox in... Lion Quest Infinity. This hot new title will be available on Steam from the 5th March. Please look forward to this release!

notes.title: Announcing Linux support for Lion Quest Infinity
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39023933/ebbe755af0f332bc98f477089de4ebfc1647f0af.jpg[/img]

Hello and good news. Today's special announcement is that Lion Quest Infinity will launch with support for Linux as well as Windows and macOS. Please look forward to this upcoming release next year!
